summary: Join asynchronous route contributions after complete settlement
implementation_scope: Occurrence-keyed host join with retained owners and ordered reduction; producer execution is external

agent_guidance.use_when: Independent producers contribute to one routed result and need a shared publication boundary
agent_guidance.avoid_when: A single fused operation already produces the complete result without separate contributions
provides: Unique occurrence acceptance and source retention
All-producer readiness, ordered reduction and terminal error propagation
engine_supplies: Execution receipts whose done/result certify completion and success
preserve: One result per route occurrence, including repeated experts
All readers settle before owners release
Successful complete join before output publication
adapt: Reduction method with declared numerical criteria
Native dependency ordering in place of host polling

code_files.purpose: Occurrence-keyed host join with retained owners and ordered reduction; producer execution is external

requires.hardware: Python 3.11+ and standard library for the host reference; backend hardware is an engine choice
requires.model: Any operation with multiple independent contributions; no fixed expert or vector geometry
requires.workload: Potential producer overlap where transfer and join costs are worth paying

contract.input: Unique route positions, physical-settlement receipts and retained source owners
contract.output: Merged contribution or terminal error after complete settlement
contract.ownership: Accepted work retains its source. The caller supplies execution/quiescence; receipt.done must certify physical completion.
contract.failure: Reject duplicate/unknown work and early settlement. Failed quiescence retains the accepted owner set.
contract.core_boundary: Connect contribution readiness to core progress and include every producer in drain/retirement.

validation.host: Host fixtures and worked example cover missing/delayed contributions, ordered joins, errors and abort retention
validation.native: Native overlap, stream ordering and arithmetic remain unqualified by host fixtures
validation.performance: Unmeasured for a native engine; host fixture success is not a speed claim
